title: Zero-Dimensional Attention Topology for Linguistic Acceptability
abstract: arXiv:2611.22312v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Topological summaries of Transformer attention provide sentence representations for linguistic acceptability classification. We examine a zero-dimensional persistent-homology ($H_0$) representation that summarizes minimum-spanning-tree merge values from 144 symmetrized BERT attention graphs into 1,440 features. The retrospective evaluation uses 8,517 downstream training sentences and 521 in-domain and 497 out-of-domain CoLA validation sentences after data-integrity filtering. The recorded out-of-domain Matthews correlation coefficients are 0.438 for the topological representation and 0.508 for attention statistics, compared with 0.545 for BERT. Attention-feature results are retained aggregate measurements; BERT predictions are rescored and length controls are refitted from the accompanying records. Analytical results show that the representation retains token-count information and discards a class of directional attention differences. So

translated_title: 面向语言可接受性的零维注意力拓扑
translated_abstract: Transformer注意力的拓扑摘要为语言可接受性分类提供了句子表示。我们研究了一种零维持续同调（$H_0$）表示，它将来自144个对称化BERT注意力图的最小生成树合并值汇总为1,440个特征。在经过数据完整性过滤后，回顾性评估使用了8,517个下游训练句子，以及521个域内和497个域外的CoLA验证句子。记录的域外Matthews相关系数为：拓扑表示为0.438，注意力统计为0.508，而BERT为0.545。注意力特征结果是保留的汇总测量值；BERT预测结果根据附带记录进行了重新评分，并重新拟合了长度控制。分析结果表明，该表示保留了词元数量信息，但丢弃了一类方向性注意力差异。
tldr: 本文提出用零维持续同调将144个对称化BERT注意力图压缩为1,440个拓扑特征用于语言可接受性分类，但实验表明其域外性能（MCC 0.438）低于注意力统计（0.508）和BERT本身（0.545），且该表示会丢失方向性注意力差异信息。
en_tdlr: This paper compresses 144 symmetrized BERT attention graphs into 1,440 topological features via zero-dimensional persistent homology for linguistic acceptability classification, but finds that this representation underperforms both attention statistics (MCC 0.438 vs. 0.508) and BERT itself (0.545) out-of-domain, while discarding directional attention differences.
